threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus driver doesn’t stop at the actual bus stop. We know he’s just taking a breather, mate.
Caught the N87 last night. Two blokes arguing over who saw the most pigeons in Clapham Common. Their count? 37. No clue how they got there.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a man in full tuxedo play chess with a street artist outside of my Kiezkiosk. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a kebab shop next to a gallery showcasing contemporary art, both packed at 3 AM on a Saturday.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their choice of taco truck; if they call it "La Taqueria" without the "La," they’re one of us.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 49 today, and the usual folks pushing the limits on the bus had an impromptu poetry slam. Only in SF do delays come with live art.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think it's all about Gaudí here, but the real charm is tucked in the quiet squares, where locals sip coffee and linger well past sunset.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them easily—they're the ones still struggling to open the metro ticket machines without staring blankly for minutes.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when the bus driver calls out stops. Most locals just nod and know when to jump off without a second thought.
Last night on the 69, a guy serenaded us with a ukulele version of 'Wonderwall'. Only in Brixton do you get gigs on the way home!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The sound of a spontaneous street concert from the Kotti steps, while a vendor sells fresh falafel nearby. That’s when it hit me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you can find spontaneous street art battles every weekend. Just grab a beer and watch creativity collide on the walls.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to avoid 16th and Mission during rush hour; it’s a circus. Outsiders just get lost in the shuffle, oblivious to the delays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy negotiate with a pigeon on the Civic Center Muni platform today. They were in a fierce standoff until the bird won and flew away.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all Gràcia's plazas are just for sipping coffee. But locals know they're actually mini concert stages on the weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confusion over the 5pm dinner time; they still expect a meal at 7. The locals have long adjusted.
